OpenAI's own API uses `POST /v1/audio/speech` for text-to-speech, and OpenAI-compatible servers usually copy that path. As far as I know, though, Ollama's OpenAI-compatible API covers chat completions, completions, embeddings, and models, not speech generation. I can't confirm that Ollama on macOS serves audio or streams it through that endpoint. If this project does, it is probably through a wrapper or a separate TTS server.
